scientific_integrity: Analytical proof gives the unrestricted theorem; finite standard-library numerical checks are corroborative, not independent certification or a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Real Euclidean projections on circular cones with spatial dimension at least two, measured in coordinate maximum norm. Scalar optimizations remain implicit, and finite-dimensional branch winner at both asymptotic transition apertures is not classified. Historical priority remains conditional on available literature.
title: Three sharp aperture regimes for coordinatewise stability of Euclidean circular-cone projections
